scene.description: Direct-frontal BEFORE/AFTER 50/50 horizontal split occupies the middle of the frame. A two-line ALL CAPS headline anchors the top of the frame: line 1 BLACK ('TIRED OF YOUR OLD WINDOWS?'), line 2 RED ('GET 40% OFF — LIMITED TIME'). The left panel shows the BEFORE — peeling old window frame in an existing exterior opening; the right panel shows the AFTER — fresh white-frame divided-light window in the same opening. Yellow rectangular BEFORE/AFTER badges sit at the bottom corners of each panel (bottom-left of left panel = BEFORE; bottom-right of right panel = AFTER). A Google Business Review badge with CDW's actual rating + 5-star row sits in the top-right corner. Compliance fine-print line at the bottom edge. NO person, NO founder. Hero is the photo pair.

flex_notes.ref_value: GET 40% OFF WITH OUR SPRING SPECIAL
justifications: Seasonal language ('SPRING SPECIAL') dates the ad; if it runs into summer/fall it reads stale and forces a re-cut on a structurally fine clone.

Pairs with the locked vague-terms compliance language — the headline's 'LIMITED TIME' mirrors the compliance line ('Limited-time offer — see in-home estimate for details'), keeping the CYA disclosure visible at two reading heights (headline + fine print).
Word count parity — REF-002 line 2 has 7 words; the swap has 6 words; within the ±1–2 word 1% flex budget.
Direct-response energy preserved — question on line 1 + offer/urgency answer on line 2; black/red ALL CAPS rhythm; same line count.
